message.content:
Major critics of Copernicus included conservative clergy, Aristotelian scholars, Church censors who restricted his book, and astronomers such as Tycho Brahe and Christopher Clavius.
Did their objections rest on Scripture, natural philosophy, or the absence of observed stellar parallax?
Their resistance shows how deeply the heliocentric idea challenged the old cosmic order!
